messages.subject: question about senstivity analysis
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,
I would like to do sensitivity analysis after propensity score analysis.
I noted that there was sensitivity function in “twang” package before, 
however, the function had been removed from the updated “twang” package.I am so confused about that.
I carried out two methods in my article, one was propensity score matching then using regression for treatment effect estimation,
the other was using propensity score weighting.My question is how to do sensitivity analysis for this two kinds of methods?
Packages rbounds  seems only focus on wilcoxon signed rank test.
Thanks a lot!
Meijing Wu
Department of Health statistics
Second military medical university
Shanghai, China
